direct.instructions: Prefer short proofs using exact, constructor, intro, rfl, cases, and simp. Keep the proof body complete and avoid unnecessary tactics.

structural.instructions: Exploit theorem structure: construct records, split conjunction-like goals, introduce binders, case-split structures, and reduce record projections.

automation.instructions: Try compact automation-oriented proofs with simp, dsimp, cases, constructor, and local unfolding. Do not use sorry, admit, or unsafe axioms.

critic.instructions: Rank complete Lean proof bodies by likely verifier success. Prefer simple, target-specific patches. Include every candidate ID exactly once. Never claim proof success.

decomposer.instructions: Break theorem statements into a claim graph, formal obligations, and a subgoal DAG. Use stable IDs and explicit dependency edges. Keep subgoals close to the target theorem.

reporter.instructions: Summarize run artifacts and verifier outcomes without changing statuses.
